OCR: PNG image extraction with OCR enabled. In WASM this exercises the Uint8Array bridge parameter and Promise await in the generated OcrBackend bridge.

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"bytes\":\"images/test_hello_world.png\",\"config\":{},\"filename\":\"test_hello_world.png\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\"}", "{}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
